maya (People Ops): Quick all-hands follow-up thread on remote/hybrid + office ops. Asking questions here and we'll answer with links.
adrian (Eng): If I book a month of satellite work, what's the lodging rule?
maya (People Ops): Long stays: request corporate rate via travel form. Default caps: $250/night normal, $325/night high-cost cities. For stays >14 days, Finance will review monthly housing options.
sasha (Eng-Infra): Are contractors allowed indefinite desk access during a project?
carlos (People Ops): Contractors get 3 free day passes per 30 days; extended access requires sponsor + vendor onboarding. Send COI to security.
adrian (Eng): What about family joining an offsite?
rebecca (People Ops): Not covered by default. Childcare reimbursement up to $150/day for overnight company events with manager approval. Exceptions via form.
adrian (Eng): Visa letters timeline?
maya (People Ops): Start 6-8 weeks before travel and attach passport scan. We cover expedited fees with approval.
offsite-bot: Poll "Preferred offsite month" Apr / May / Sep  results in 24h.
maya (People Ops): Thanks all 91; will pin a short FAQ in #people-ops and update the handbook links.
